passages.text: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
passages.sermon: A blessed man does not follow the advice of wicked people.\r\nHe does not stand in the way that sinners take.\r\nHe does not sit where mockers gather.
passages.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־ הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃

passages.text: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
passages.sermon:
This man loves the Law of the LORD.
He finds joy in God's Law.
He thinks about God's Law during the day.
He thinks about God's Law at night.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃

passages.text: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
passages.sermon:
The righteous man is like a tree.
Someone planted this tree by streams of water.
This tree gives its fruit at the right time.
Its leaf does not wither.
Everything this man does succeeds.
passages.original: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־ פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־ יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃

passages.text: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
passages.sermon:
The wicked are not like the righteous.
The wicked do not delight in the law of the LORD.
The wicked do not meditate on God's law day and night.
The wicked are not like a tree planted by streams of water.
The wicked are like chaff.
The wind blows the chaff away.
The wicked have no stability.
The wicked are easily scattered.
passages.original: לֹא־ כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־ כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃

passages.text: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
passages.sermon: The wicked will not stand when God judges people.\r\nSinners will not join the assembly of the righteous.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ לֹא־ יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃

passages.text: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
passages.sermon:
The LORD knows the path of the righteous.
The LORD watches over the righteous.
The way of the wicked will perish.
God does not protect the wicked.
The wicked will be destroyed.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
